messages:
Maya Chen: Morning — quick weekly check for Northwave. We saw a spike in overall errors this morning: 5xx +38%, 504/timeouts up sharply, and some 429 bursts. Dropping the top failing endpoints below for triage.

AlertBot: [ALERT] Northwave: 5xx rate +42% vs baseline. Peak window 02:10–02:40 UTC. Counts: 5xx=1,240, 504=420, 429=180.

Maya Chen: Top failing routes (sampled logs):
```
/edge/v1/generate         5xx  540 errors (43%)
/v1/embed                429  180 errors (15%)
/batch/infer             504  320 errors (25%)
/ctl/prefetch            500  200 errors (16%)
```

Jared Ortiz: Looking into runtime traces now. Initial impression: autoscaler delayed scale-up during the burst; several model workers hit OOM and returned 500s then 504s on proxied requests.

Jared Ortiz: snippet from runtime logs: 
```text
2026-03-19T02:22:09Z ERROR 504 gateway_timeout route=/batch/infer worker=gw-7 scale_event=delayed
2026-03-19T02:22:10Z ERROR 500 model_error route=/edge/v1/generate model=gptx-8B quant=fp16
```

Omar N'diaye: Confirmed autoscaler backoff — min-instances was 0 for their dedicated pool, scale-up throttled due to cooldown. Took ~90s to reach steady capacity. Also saw high KV-cache miss rate on /edge routes which amplified latency.

Priya Desai: Northwave onboards heavy batched embeddings every morning at 02:15 UTC (client v2.1). They're burst-parallelizing ~120 concurrent embed requests which explains the 429 spikes on /v1/embed. I flagged this to their eng lead.

Maya Chen: Quick risk/impact summary for renewal playbook: outages affected 8% of Northwave API calls during window, latency SLO breached for their top 3 routes. Renewal risk increases if we don't propose mitigation.

Jared Ortiz: Short-term mitigations I recommend:
- bump min-instances to 2 for Northwave dedicated pool immediately
- enable faster scale policy (reduce cooldown to 10s)
- temporarily raise per-connection queue for /batch/infer to avoid gateway timeouts

Omar N'diaye: I'm on the infra change — will schedule a config update to increase min-instances to 4 for the next 48h and reduce cooldown. Will post PR and deploy window.

Priya Desai: I'll draft a customer note with two asks: add client-side exponential backoff + limit embed concurrency, and confirm they can shift their heavy batch to a staggered window. Also offering a 2-week burst credit to cover potential extra spend.

Maya Chen: Action items:
1) Omar — infra change (min-instances=4) + PR link once scheduled. ETA 6h.
2) Jared — follow up on model OOM root cause and patch model-run configs. ETA 24h.
3) Priya — customer communication + schedule enablement call. ETA 24h.

Omar N'diaye: PR created: https://git.redwood.internal/r/infra/patches/2387 — deploying in 15m.

Jared Ortiz: I'll attach a small log bundle for the on-call runbook. 

Priya Desai: Scheduling Tuesday 09:00 PDT enablement call with Northwave. I'll include recommended client change snippets.

Maya Chen: Thanks team. I'll include this in the weekly account health email and mark renewal flag for follow-up. :eyes: 

AlertBot: Incident closed (suppression): autoscaler-change applied, error rates trending down after 02:58 UTC. Follow-up required for client-side changes.
